mistake_summary: Forgot to instruct AI to use unstyled UI primitives (BaseUI, Reka-UI) instead of raw HTML elements.
recommended_fix: Add UI primitive library selection to the /pick project-init questionnaire.

mistake_summary: Forgot to specify TanStack Charts / D3 for curves; AI self-implemented chart curves.
recommended_fix: Lock charting library in /pick init and wrap it behind a charts-builder adapter.

mistake_summary: Agent wrote raw inline SVG code instead of using a production icon library and didn't ask which library to use.
recommended_fix: Choose icon library in /pick; add a gate flagging raw multi-path inline <svg> in UI components.

mistake_summary: Agent consistently misses tooltips and ARIA attributes on hover/interactive components.
recommended_fix: Add accessibility/tooltip check in UI polish pass and E2E a11y audit.

mistake_summary: Filters-toolbox only filters one chart or partial data instead of affecting all page data and KPI cards.
recommended_fix: Bind filters-toolbox to URL query params or page-level store and verify all KPIs/charts subscribe to it.

mistake_summary: Agent forgets to add loading skeletons to components unless explicitly reminded.
recommended_fix: Include skeleton coverage in the UI polish pass checklist.

mistake_summary: Agent omits full interactive states (clicked, disabled, loading, empty, error) on custom/builder components beyond basic Buttons.
recommended_fix: Require a state matrix (default/hover/active/disabled/loading/error) for all interactive components.

mistake_summary: Sign-up and auth pages are designed too simply and look unprofessional.
recommended_fix: Provide a reference layout or UI taste skill rule for auth flows.

mistake_summary: Agent avoids using images in the app/design unless explicitly instructed.
recommended_fix: Specify visual asset strategy (real photos/illustrations) during /pick or UI spec.

mistake_summary: Agent forgets custom scrollbar, webkit styling, and text selection colors matching the brand.
recommended_fix: Add brand scrollbar and ::selection tokens to the global CSS starter template.

mistake_summary: Oversimplifies dropdowns and searchboxes (raw <select> look instead of extensible base supporting search, filter buttons, multi-select).
recommended_fix: Define composable Dropdown and SearchBox primitives with extension slots in UI pitfalls.

mistake_summary: Incorrect z-index stacking when opening a modal over another modal.
recommended_fix: Use a centralized z-index scale or portal stack manager (via BaseUI/Reka-UI) instead of arbitrary z-index values.

mistake_summary: Forgets micro-transitions (e.g., button expanding for spinner, panel collapsing to rail).
recommended_fix: Add motion/transition checklist item to the UI polish pass.

mistake_summary: Under-designs modals and bottom sheets (missing titles, icons, visual polish, expand controls).
recommended_fix: Standardize a reusable Modal/Sheet shell component with header icon, title, and expand slots.

mistake_summary: Partial responsiveness: misses some elements and never E2E-tests responsive viewports unless told.
recommended_fix: Run Playwright viewport matrix tests (mobile/tablet/desktop) checking horizontal overflow and visibility.

mistake_summary: Niche components fail to support light/dark or brand themes.
recommended_fix: Ban hardcoded hex/rgb colors in components via linter; enforce CSS semantic theme tokens.

mistake_summary: No state persistence (e.g., via URL query parameters), causing user inputs/steps to vanish on refresh.
recommended_fix: Persist filter, tab, pagination, and multi-step wizard state in URL query params by default.

mistake_summary: Skeletons look generic/monotonous (identical shimmer speed, angle, and pace).
recommended_fix: Define varied skeleton shimmer tokens/presets in the UI design system.

mistake_summary: Builds a single LTR skeleton component without respecting RTL writing direction.
recommended_fix: Make skeleton shimmer direction and layout alignment inherit logical CSS / dir='rtl'.

mistake_summary: Hardcodes fixed color arrays (e.g., 5 colors for pie charts) that break when data exceeds 5 items.
recommended_fix: Provide a deterministic dynamic color + accessible contrast text generator helper.

mistake_summary: Uses raw and
recommended_fix: Enable framework ESLint rules (@next/next/no-img-element, etc.) as a Tier 1 gate.

mistake_summary: Fails to DRY/reuse established project global styling and CSS builder files.
recommended_fix: Document global utility/token files in AGENTS.md and check for duplicate CSS blocks during review.

mistake_summary: Duplicating TypeScript types across files because no guard prevents it.
recommended_fix: Centralize shared types in a types/contracts package and detect duplicate type names via AST gate.

mistake_summary: Invents ad-hoc error styles/messages (especially in toasts) instead of using established error-arch files.
recommended_fix: Enforce error-arch message/factory usage via lint rule and prohibit inline raw error strings in UI notifications.

mistake_summary: Only stores secrets in .env, hardcoding important config keys (like navigator.locks names) in code.
recommended_fix: Define an env-config schema covering both secrets and operational keys/identifiers.

mistake_summary: Scatters environment checks (if localhost, if 127.x, if dev) instead of encapsulating env helpers.
recommended_fix: Create a single env.ts module (isDev/isTest/isProd) and flag raw 'localhost'/'127.0.0.1' checks via gate.

mistake_summary: Violates global/shared vs. local boundaries in multi-app repos (e.g., dumping all tests in root tests/).
recommended_fix: Explicitly map workspace boundaries (apps/* vs packages/*) in arch spec and verify directory placement.

mistake_summary: Prefers broad/generic types instead of narrowed types and strong type hinting.
recommended_fix: Ship concrete narrowed-type patterns in typing/pitfalls.md and enforce strict TS/Pyright configs.

mistake_summary: Hardcodes frontend and API route strings instead of typed routes / navigation.paths.ts / route prefix helpers.
recommended_fix: Mandate typed route builders and flag raw route string literals outside the routes module.

mistake_summary: Hardcodes constants and default values in multiple files instead of a single source of truth.
recommended_fix: Centralize constants in a dedicated config/constants module and reference them everywhere.

mistake_summary: Forgets which quality gates to protect in the project (no unified gates plan).
recommended_fix: Add gates-arch.md to the arch skill to select active Tier 1/2/3 gates at project start.

mistake_summary: Omits API versioning directory structure (e.g., v1/) needed for future migrations.
recommended_fix: Make /api/v1/ directory structure a default template rule in backend/arch skill.

mistake_summary: Leaves catch blocks / error handlers empty.
recommended_fix: Enable no-empty catch linter rule as a strict Tier 1 Blocker gate.

mistake_summary: Does not use a professional logging library unless explicitly told.
recommended_fix: Select logging library (e.g., pino, winston, structlog) in /pick and ban console.log in prod code.

mistake_summary: Uses raw `throw new Error()` instead of the project's dedicated `appError` factory.
recommended_fix: Add a Tier 1 lint/AST gate disallowing raw `throw new Error` in favor of `appError`.

mistake_summary: Marries third-party libraries directly inside app code instead of wrapping them in adapters (e.g., charts-builder).
recommended_fix: Restrict direct third-party imports to dedicated wrapper/adapter modules (eslint no-restricted-imports).

mistake_summary: Silences type errors with workarounds (e.g., `as any`, `@ts-ignore`) instead of fixing the root type issue.
recommended_fix: Block `@ts-ignore`, `@ts-expect-error` without reason, and `as any` in Tier 1 gate.

mistake_summary: Writes poorly structured module internals unless guided (varies by model).
recommended_fix: Provide explicit module layout conventions (imports -> types -> constants -> public API -> helpers).

mistake_summary: Lets files grow to thousands of lines without refactoring, violating OCP and burning tokens on future edits.
recommended_fix: Add a Tier 2 file-line-count gate (e.g., >350 lines triggers a refactor warning).

mistake_summary: Fakes functionality to 'look working' (in-memory/temp file uploads, fake config/i18n) instead of real DB tables and storage buckets.
recommended_fix: Explicitly verify real DB/storage wiring in Tier 1 checks and ban temp/in-memory storage in prod handlers.

mistake_summary: Auth bugs in one-shot builds: session lost on page refresh, or signed-in users can still access sign-in pages.
recommended_fix: Add mandatory auth E2E tests: signup -> refresh (stays logged in) and authenticated visit to /signin (redirects).

mistake_summary: Misuses timezone-aware timestamps (either omitting them or overusing them regardless of region/legal/domain needs).
recommended_fix: Define the project's date/timezone storage policy explicitly during spec phase.

mistake_summary: Writes a DB seed script but forgets to write a DB reset script.
recommended_fix: Pair every `db:seed` task with a `db:reset` script in backend checklist.

mistake_summary: Mixes mock/fixture fake data directly inside production source code or API functions even when told to use seeded DB.
recommended_fix: Isolate fixtures to tests/ or seeds/ directories and flag mock arrays inside src/ via gate.

mistake_summary: Forgot to specify how admin component translations should be structured even when app supports i18n.
recommended_fix: Include admin i18n strategy (shared vs. separate namespace) in /pick init.

mistake_summary: Mixes English words into non-English (e.g., Arabic) interfaces without asking the user's preference.
recommended_fix: Ask in intake if target locale must be 100% pure (no English bleed) and enforce in i18n review.

mistake_summary: Fails to normalize Western digits to Arabic-Indic numerals in Arabic views.
recommended_fix: Use a centralized Intl.NumberFormat / locale number formatter helper instead of raw numbers.

mistake_summary: Hardcodes default locale across multiple files instead of adding an `is_default` column to the DB translations table.
recommended_fix: Store default locale in DB schema (`is_default`) or a single config source of truth.

mistake_summary: Forgets the most critical E2E test: verifying pages render healthily with ZERO console errors, ZERO warnings, and no Next.js/Nuxt error overlays.
recommended_fix: Make a global page-health E2E spec (fail on console.error/warn or error overlay) mandatory in every web project.

mistake_summary: Ignores build/runtime/linter warnings even when fixable, until explicitly told.
recommended_fix: Run linters/checks with `--max-warnings=0` in Tier 1/3 gates.

mistake_summary: Only seeds partial data during E2E tests instead of seeding all required entities.
recommended_fix: Require E2E setup to call the complete canonical seed script and assert entity counts.

mistake_summary: E2E tests only cover happy paths, skipping loading, failure, empty, and error states.
recommended_fix: Require each critical flow E2E suite to include at least one failure/empty-state test.

mistake_summary: Runs linter and ignores reported issues unless explicitly instructed to fix them.
recommended_fix: Make linter exit code a hard Tier 1 gate with auto-fix run before waking the LLM.

mistake_summary: Ignores project coding guidelines (like strong type hinting) inside test files.
recommended_fix: Ask user in intake whether tests follow the same strictness as src/ and configure tsconfig/linter accordingly.

mistake_summary: Omits full descriptions and help details for CLI commands.
recommended_fix: Require every CLI command and option to have a non-empty description and usage example.

mistake_summary: Omits opt-in / opt-out boolean flag pairs (e.g., `--hint` / `--no-hint`) unless told.
recommended_fix: Ask CLI flag preference in intake; enforce paired boolean flags in cli/pitfalls.md when enabled.

mistake_summary: Omits short aliases (`ls`, `-o`) and skips them on collisions instead of resolving (`-o`/`-O` or alternate letters).
recommended_fix: Add a CLI alias resolution rule (lowercase -> uppercase -> next distinct letter) in cli/pitfalls.md.

mistake_summary: Hardcodes guessed package versions in package.json instead of running the package manager to install latest/stable.
recommended_fix: Mandate installing deps via package manager CLI (`bun add`, `pnpm add`, `uv add`) instead of hand-editing versions.

mistake_summary: Never suggests updating outdated dependencies even when deprecation/security warnings appear.
recommended_fix: Include a dependency audit/outdated check in the `production` skill.

mistake_summary: Does not keep package versions synchronized across monorepo workspaces.
recommended_fix: Use Bun/pnpm catalogs or syncpack as a Tier 2/3 monorepo gate.

mistake_summary: Forgets app logo and favicon.
recommended_fix: Check for favicon and brand logo assets in the Tier 3 `production` release gate.

mistake_summary: Forgets complementary pages (global loading, 404, and error boundary pages).
recommended_fix: Verify existence of loading/error/not-found routes in the `production` skill gate.

mistake_summary: Forgets `sitemap.xml` and `robots.txt` even when 100% SEO is requested.
recommended_fix: Add deterministic file/route existence check for sitemap and robots.txt in Tier 3 SEO gate.

mistake_summary: Displays internal developer error codes (e.g., `XTF`) in the admin console, confusing admins with developers.
recommended_fix: Separate user/admin-friendly messages from internal diagnostic codes (log internal codes, hide from UI).

mistake_summary: Leaves unused functions, dead exports, and unused installed dependencies in the codebase.
recommended_fix: Allow during dev, but run knip/depcheck/vulture as a Tier 3 `production` gate before release.

mistake_summary: Uses unicode icons/emojis everywhere (and sneaks them into README/docs even when banned in code).
recommended_fix: Run a repo-wide regex gate script scanning both source code and docs/README for banned unicode symbols.

mistake_summary: Even with `/pick` skill, agent misses useful libraries, suggestions, or deeper architectural thinking.
recommended_fix: Upgrade /pick with a structured domain checklist (UI primitives, icons, charts, logging, auth, i18n).

mistake_summary: Doesn't cache library `llms.txt` and docs locally in `references/<lib>/`, causing repeated tool calls or stale knowledge.
recommended_fix: Create a `docs-cache` skill/hook that saves library llms.txt & markdown docs to `references/<lib>/` as a golden rule.

mistake_summary: Miswrites `sync-blocks` content/behavior despite instructions in AGENTS.md.
recommended_fix: Add dedicated sync-block schema/examples or a validator script instead of relying on prose in AGENTS.md.

mistake_summary: Vague prompts like 'write clean code' have zero effect without concrete instructions on HOW.
recommended_fix: Replace vague quality adjectives with concrete skill rules, examples, and deterministic gates.

mistake_summary: Becomes rigid on a broken approach instead of stepping back to propose a better solution.
recommended_fix: Add a meta-rule: after 2 failed attempts on the same issue, stop and propose 2 alternative architectures.

mistake_summary: Makes false claims about third-party libraries (e.g., claiming a library uses Puppeteer when it doesn't).
recommended_fix: Require verifying library internals via cached `references/<lib>/` docs or live search before recommending.

mistake_summary: First proposed solution is rarely the best unless pushed to think deeper.
recommended_fix: Require brief trade-off comparison (2 options + recommendation) for non-trivial design decisions.

mistake_summary: Ignores pre-existing bugs outside its current edit AND never asks the user's quality/craftsmanship preferences (complexity, classes vs. functions, maps vs. if-chains, docstyle).
recommended_fix: Capture code craftsmanship & boy-scout-rule preferences once during project intake.
